### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**13** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/vitest.config.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/vitest.config.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **12** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ec57bbc64f67113b8c8b0e1a4de50bef1b24aec2` — the merge of head `681e57083da813b74f92b954d8510e739d6987b5` into base `fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ec57bbc64f67113b8c8b0e1a4de50bef1b24aec2 && git checkout ec57bbc64f67113b8c8b0e1a4de50bef1b24aec2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048 681e57083da813b74f92b954d8510e739d6987b5 && git checkout -B drift-repro fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048 && git merge --no-ff 681e57083da813b74f92b954d8510e739d6987b5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## L1 review (L1-d) · 2026-11-17T14:03Z

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: `cd86ab2d2ba659389771ed2e93d832432c7bf716`

Read at that head: the file list (14 paths), the full diff, the PR body, card #34729 with triage 6943452080 and 6944467388, claim 6947880022, surface amendment 6949642343, os-dev report 6949609138, and the 69 check-runs (all green). `check-governed-merges` reports 0 of 14 paths, so the PR is not governed. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are the same in the claim, the body and the changeset. The `MessagingEmitSurface` and `installAuditWriters` option widenings are on unexported or structural types, so no contract face is touched and no L2 is owed.

The design reads right, and the area's points check out:
- **Two emits:** the inbox emit is unchanged. The `['email']` emit sits inside the same per-admitted-recipient loop, behind the gate, with `dedupKey = mentionEmailDedupKey(org, uid, now)`. `MessagingService.emit` treats a repeated `dedupKey` as a no-op (`messaging-service.ts` ~:1355, and the UNIQUE index decides a race). The bell reads `sys_inbox_message` (`useInboxBell`), so the e-mail-only event row adds nothing to the inbox.
- **Deep link:** `AuthManager.getConsoleUrl` is the public composer on the registered `auth` service (`auth-plugin.ts:1004`). A bare `/_console/{object}/{id}` is hosted by the Console catch-all (`UnmatchedRoute` → `resolveNotificationTarget`, signed-out visitors go through login and come back), so the body's sentence on this is true. Read from source only: there is no live reading.
- **Templates:** the 11 locales equal the `AuditTranslations` key set and mirror `APPROVAL_EMAIL_LINK_LINES`. The code-declared tier sits under org `sys_notification_template` rows.
- **Daily cap:** the hosted cap is noted in the PR body, as triage asked.

### Must-fix
- **M1: the recipient-gate pins no longer see the new channel that carries the comment preview.** In `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`, the `comment()` helper (:168), `postTold`/`editTold` (:475, :486) and the pins at :539, :579 and :595 now filter to `topic === 'collab.mention' && !e.channels`. So does `audit-writers.test.ts` at :2696 and :2709. The `['email']` emit sends the 240-character comment preview to a mailbox outside the platform. No suite now runs a withholding gate together with the e-mail emit: `mention-email.integration.test.ts` admits every mention. If a later edit moved the e-mail emit out of the admitted loop, for example to send it once per comment to every name in `mentions`, every suite would stay green.
  Fix:
  - Keep the whole-topic filter wherever the pin says nothing may be emitted (`toEqual([])` at :539, and audit-writers :2696 and :2709). Those pins pass unchanged with the current code.
  - In the gate suite's helpers, also assert that the e-mail emits' audiences equal the inbox emits' audiences, or add one case where BOB, who is withheld, gets neither emit and CAROL gets both.
  - Show it bites: an ablation that sends the e-mail to the raw mention list must go red.
- **M2: claim file surface.** Five existing test files are edited, and neither the claim ("new card-named tests") nor amendment 6949642343 names them: `audit-hook-object-scope.test.ts`, `audit-plugin-host-locale.test.ts`, `audit-write-locale-settings-seam.integration.test.ts`, `audit-writers.test.ts` and `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`. This is paper: one more amendment line on #34729. The edits are needed, because each counted emits by topic.

### Should-fix
None.

### Notes
- **N1, changeset sentences checked against the diff:**
  - The inbox notice is unchanged.
  - `channels: ['email']` goes through `messaging.emit`.
  - The `(collab.mention, email, enabled: false)` mute works (integration case "muted").
  - The window is clock-aligned at 10 minutes, so at most 2 in any ten minutes and 144 a day (`Math.floor(nowMs / 600000)`).
  - The subject is the localized title, and the body is the preview plus the link line in every catalog locale.
  - The org template overrides the built-in one.
  - With no auth service the link stays relative.
  - With no record there is no e-mail (`recordPath` null).
  All true. No `content/docs` or `packages/spec` sentence about mention channels is made false (grep `mention` × inbox/email/notif).
- **N2, evidence:** the integration suite runs the real `MessagingServicePlugin` outbox, dispatcher, preference filter and template tier. The window ablation (6 deliveries against 4) bites. The approvals CONTROL is green unchanged. `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` were NOT MEASURED locally, and the CI lanes covering them are green at this head.
- **N3, untested locale reach:** a non-`en` recipient's locale reaching the template is not exercised (every rig user is `en`). Nothing is owed under the card, but a one-line `zh-CN` case would cost little while M1 is open.
- **N4, unfiled observation:** the PR body's note that the approval e-mail link `${publicBaseUrl}/system/approvals?request=ID` may miss the `/_console` mount is not filed. That is for the seat to route: measure it on a booted `os serve`, or have coordinator#1 file it. It is not this PR's.

A new head owes a delta read: M1's test change plus its ablation, and the amendment for M2.

## L1 review (L1-d), delta read · 2026-11-17T15:49Z

Outside `*.test.ts`, the PR's diff against its merge base is the same line for line at both heads. The file list is the same 14 paths. Not governed (0 of 14 paths, 691 lines). All 69 check-runs at this head are completed, and every one is success or skipped. That includes Test Core (all 10 shards, with 4/10 green this time), Test UI (all 16), TypeScript Type Check, Lint & Repo Gates, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and the Governed Surface Queue Guard. The red 4/10 at `fba6728c5` was the attestation upload (`ECONNRESET`), not a test.

### Must-fix
None.
- **M1 is closed.** In `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`, every helper that reads emits now goes through `mentionEmits`: `comment`, `postTold`, `editTold`, and the reads at the old :579 and :595. `mentionEmits` asserts three things: the `['email']` audiences equal the inbox audiences in order, no third shape exists, and it returns the inbox list. The pins' existing audience expectations therefore now bind the e-mail too.
  - A new case posts `[BOB.id, CAROL.id, BOB.email]`. BOB, who is withheld, appears in neither emit. CAROL gets exactly `[inbox, email]`, and the e-mail carries `body` and the relative `mentionUrl`.
  - The nothing-emitted pins read the whole `collab.mention` topic again. That covers the nested-hook pin (old :539) and the no-gate and failing-gate pins in `audit-writers.test.ts` (:2696 and :2709). The admitted-recipients pin there also asserts the e-mail audience `[['user-2']]`.
  - The dev's ablation adds one ungated `['email']` emit to the raw mention list. It turns 24 cases red across the two suites, and the restore was checked back to the HEAD blob.
  - The remaining `!e.channels` reads are title and locale reads (host-locale, settings-seam, writers :1382/:1498/:2670/:2684), not gate pins.
- **M2 is closed.** Claim amendment 6950318953 on #34729 names all five existing test files: `audit-hook-object-scope`, `audit-plugin-host-locale`, `audit-write-locale-settings-seam.integration`, `audit-writers` and `mention-recipient-gate.integration`. Every path in the 14-file list is now inside the claim as amended (6949642343 + 6950318953).

### Should-fix
None.

### Notes
- N3 is answered. `mention-email.integration.test.ts` adds a zh-CN reader (`sys_user.locale` `zh-CN`, and the rig's `getLocale` follows the same per-user map). The test pins the subject `Alice 提到了你` and the text `…\n\n查看评论：<origin>/_console/<object>/t1` end to end through the outbox.
- The other notes from 6950295328 stand: the dedupKey design, the 10-minute window against the hosted mail cap, and the untested approval-link inference left in the PR's notes.

Landing: not governed, all checks green on this exact head. Area o3-G lands it. `Fixes #34729`. A later push owes a delta read.
